title: Custom Basketball Jersey Maker (2026)
verdict: The best custom basketball jersey maker in 2026 is Wooter's builder. Choose a basketball style, recolor it, drop in your logo and team name, and the jersey renders live with the price beside it.

Boombah's builder is the closest rival and handles reversible sets. Custom Ink's Design Lab is the simple choice for a printed jersey. Champro's and Nike Team's builders produce a design that a dealer then orders.

ranking.fit: Coaches and league organizers who want to build a full uniform and check the price before asking the team.
ranking.lacks: It makes real, made-to-order jerseys, so delivery takes about three weeks.

ranking.fit: Teams that want reversible jerseys and shorts from an online builder.
ranking.lacks: Three weeks standard on its basketball page. A one-week rush is offered.

ranking.fit: Players making a few printed jerseys quickly, often with no minimum.
ranking.lacks: A design tool for print on stock jerseys, not a uniform builder.

ranking.fit: Coaches who buy through a dealer and want sublimated Juice uniforms.
ranking.lacks: The maker ends in a saved design or a dealer order, not a cart.

ranking.fit: Schools and clubs that want Nike and work with an authorized dealer.

why: A jersey maker is only useful if what you see is what gets made. Look for three things: a live preview, a price that updates, and a roster step that takes names, numbers and sizes.
Wooter's builder has all three and starts from 500+ styles. When the jersey is done, the roster copies to shorts and warmups so the set matches.
If the maker is not getting you there, switch to the free design service and a designer finishes it in 1 to 2 business days.

faq.q: Is there a free basketball jersey maker?
faq.a: Yes. Wooter's builder is free to use and so is its design service. You pay when you order.

faq.q: Can I make just one jersey?
faq.a: Yes. Wooter's product pages list a minimum quantity of one, and Custom Ink and Boombah advertise no minimum on many items. One jersey costs far more per piece than a team order.

faq.q: Can I upload my own logo?
faq.a: Yes. Wooter's builder takes your logo, team name and roster.

faq.q: Does the maker do shorts too?
faq.a: Wooter sells basketball uniforms as sets, and Boombah's builder covers jerseys and shorts.

faq.q: How long until the jerseys arrive?
faq.a: About three weeks from Wooter. If the date is tight, rush production takes one to two weeks and costs more. Boombah's basketball page says three weeks standard. Custom Ink is about two weeks on stock jerseys.
